default.description: This user's cat-identity model (best.pt). Classes are the user's cats, so detections carry cat_id. Set model_s3_save_path in sim_config.yaml (or place best.pt in models/) to use it.

yolov8s.description: Generic COCO model (80 classes, e.g. cat, dog, person). No cat identities (cat_id -1). Auto-downloaded into ./models/ on first use.
